subject: Retailify POC wrap — impact snapshot + quick permission for a one-line quote
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhang <c.zhang@retailify.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Retailify POC wrap — impact snapshot + quick permission for a one-line quote

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for running the POC with us — great to see the integration go live last week. I wanted to share a short snapshot of the outcomes we captured and ask one quick favor so we can highlight this work in our partner/solutions materials.

Key outcomes (30-day POC, production-like traffic pattern):
- Median response latency: down from ~420ms -> 290ms (≈31% reduction)
- Throughput under steady-state batching: ~2.1x improvement vs baseline
- Inference cost per 1M tokens: reduced by ~48% after KV-caching and dynamic batching
- Error rate: unchanged; quality checks showed parity on the sampled prompts used in the POC

I attached the CSV with the raw KPI breakdown and a latency comparison chart.

Would Retailify be comfortable with a short, publishable one-line quote we could use on a customer highlight? Example (totally editable):

"Redwood helped us halve inference cost while improving response times — Claire Zhang, Director of ML, Retailify"

If you'd prefer, we can capture a 10-minute recording with you or a product owner (we can provide suggested prompts/questions). No heavy legal review — just a short permission to publish a quote and a one-sentence blurb.

Proposed next steps:
1) If ok with the one-liner, either reply with edits or "Looks good"
2) Alternatively, pick a 10-min slot here: https://calendly.com/redwood/10min-advocate-call

Thanks again — excited about what you accomplished with the model tuning and caching knobs.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Customer Success | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: retailify-poc-kpis.csv, latency-comparison-chart.png

On Wed, Sep 10, 2025 at 4:12 PM Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Claire —
> 
> Thanks again for running the POC with us — great to see the integration go live last week...

Thanks, Naomi — and thank you for the clear summary. Those numbers match what my team tracked (I'll attach a very small internal digest if useful). A couple clarifications: the 2.1x throughput is for the batched inference path under our traffic simulator (not the single-request tail latency), and the cost reduction figure reflects the combination of KV caching + 4-bit quantization runs. Both are fair to call out.

We're happy to provide a short quote. Please use this as the one-liner — small edits welcome:

"Redwood’s inference runtime reduced our operational token costs by almost half and sped up response times, helping us deliver a faster shopping experience — Claire Zhang, Director of ML, Retailify."

We don't need a formal legal review. Happy to take a 10-minute call next Tuesday (Sep 16) between 10–11am PT if you want to record a quick soundbite, otherwise this written line is fine to publish.

Best,
Claire Zhang
Director of Machine Learning | Retailify
c.zhang@retailify.com
